entities.name: Forbidden PLMNs for 3GPP access
entities.description: List of forbidden PLMNs applicable for 3GPP access in N1 mode, used by 5GMM, EMM, GMM and MM protocols regardless of single or dual-registration mode.

entities.name: Forbidden PLMNs for non-3GPP access to 5GCN
entities.description: List of forbidden PLMNs applicable for non-3GPP access in N1 mode, used by 5GMM for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service
entities.description: List of forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service applicable for 3GPP access in N1 mode, used by 5GMM, EMM and GMM protocols.

entities.name: N1 mode operation
entities.description: UE operating in N1 mode with separate forbidden PLMN lists managed per access type (3GPP access or non-3GPP access).

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: Distinction between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access for managing forbidden PLMN lists independently.

entities.name: Registration mode
entities.description: UE operating in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode, which does not affect the forbidden PLMN lists usage.

relations.description: N1 mode operation establishes the use of forbidden PLMNs list for 3GPP access.
N1 mode operation establishes the use of forbidden PLMNs list for non-3GPP access.
Access type guards which forbidden PLMN list is applicable (3GPP access uses forbidden PLMNs for 3GPP access).
Access type guards which forbidden PLMN list is applicable (non-3GPP access uses forbidden PLMNs for non-3GPP access).
Registration mode guards that the forbidden PLMN list for 3GPP access is used regardless of single or dual-registration mode.
Registration mode guards that the forbidden PLMN list for GPRS service is used regardless of single or dual-registration mode.
